HtmlDescription:
La válvula Multiway es una válvula tubeless ligera fabricada en aluminio de alta calidad. Es compatible con todas las llantas, así como con todos los insertos y selladores tubeless. Esto es posible gracias a las 4 salidas situadas en el extremo inferior de la válvula.

Las válvulas son del tipo Sclaverand (francés o Presta) y tienen una junta y un núcleo de válvula reemplazables. Una vez desenroscado el núcleo de la válvula, se puede verter el sellador en el neumático a través del vástago de la válvula. El tapón de aluminio contiene la herramienta para extraer el núcleo de la válvula.

  • Orificio de la válvula en la llanta 6,5 mm de diámetro
  • Longitud: 40 mm
  • Color: negro
  • Peso: 10g

Designation: Neumático Vittoria e-Mazza 29x2.6 Enduro doble carcasa 4C G2.0
HtmlDescription:
E-MAZZA
For your Enduro e-bike
Aggressive profile with ample sipe spacing for mixed terrain
Graphene 2.0 compound reduces rolling resistance, increasing range and battery life
Progressive sipe-width pattern provides tactile grip at the knob surface, without sacrificing speed or grip
Traction without limits
The e-bike version of the new Vittoria Mazza raises the bar on e-Enduro performance for mixed terrain! Starting with a defined center tread, the e-Mazza uses deep siping in the direction of rotation, allowing the tire to roll fast while still opposing drift. The stepped leading edge rolls like a ramp, but digs in on climbs, making e-Mazza a top choice for both front and rear use. Substantial room was designed into the center tread to provide braking traction, while also accelerating cleaning. Cornering on the e-Mazza is handled by Vittoria’s trademark progressive sipe width technology, which gives a gummy inside effective edge, but without the instability that competitors experience on the outside of the tread. e-Mazza’s generous tread depth claws into a range of terrain, and is stabilized with Vittoria’s proprietary 4C compound layering process. Four separate Graphene 2.0 compounds are layered, allowing the surface of the tread to remain tacky, while the base remains planted. This ensures each effective edge is kept in place under high cornering and braking loads, leading to reduced rolling resistance, and increased wear life.

For dry terrain conditions
Available in both 320 TPI Corespun Cotton Tubular and TNT Clincher
Center “scales” are ramped, providing a fast rolling leading edge, yet sharp effective braking and cornering edges
Graphene compound technology
Made for enhanced rolling
Aggressive file tread, or super low-profile knob design? The Terreno bridges the gap between file treads, and traditional all-conditions treads. From gravel grinding to medium conditions cross racing, the Terreno Dry offers consistent performance.

Designation: Neumático bicicleta VITTORIA Corsa N.EXT 700x28c
HtmlDescription:
Velocidad y fiabilidad para los pilotos que buscan un nuevo nivel de rendimiento.

Corsa N.EXT es la nueva y emocionante incorporación a la familia Corsa. Diseñado para satisfacer las necesidades de los ciclistas entusiastas que acumulan kilómetros en largos y exigentes recorridos semanales, el Corsa N.EXT combina el inigualable conocimiento de Vittoria sobre el rendimiento en las carreras con la durabilidad de una carcasa de nylon de larga duración que utiliza un compuesto único de sílice y grafeno para mejorar la eficiencia de la rodadura, el agarre y una mayor vida útil. Para aumentar la protección contra los pinchazos, la sección central de la carcasa cuenta con 3 capas de nylon, así como un cinturón adicional de protección contra los pinchazos. Corsa N.EXT es el primer neumático de competición de carretera que incorpora un código QR -impreso en el parche caliente del neumático- para facilitar el acceso a información técnica útil sobre el neumático.

Countless effective edges work together to grip on a variety of terrain, while directional siping on each knob make traction in the roots and rocks. Using the proprietary Graphene enhanced 4C compound, the Mezcal attains the holy grail of XC tires; grip, durability, and low weight.

Designation: Neumático Vittoria Agarro 29x2.35 Trail 4C flanco gris G2.0
HtmlDescription:
AGARRO
For mixed terrain conditions
Leading edge steps for fast rolling (like a ramp), but better climbing in technical terrain at slow speeds
Progressive sipe width for tactile grip on rocks and roots
Trail category tread - More aggressive than Barzo, but less aggressive than Martello
Enduro performance, XC efficiency:
The Agarro trail tire is designed to take you there and back, with a tread profile that gives considerably more grip than an XC tire, but with less bulk than an Enduro tread. By borrowing the best traits from the popular Martello, Barzo, and Gato models, the Agarro utilizes proven technologies from both the Enduro and XC categories. This combination of performance is ideal for the Trail category, as it provides predictable grip and efficiency in a mix of conditions.

Designation: Neumático Vittoria Terreno Dry 700x38c Gravel flanco gris G2.0
HtmlDescription:
TERRENO DRY
For dry terrain conditions
Center scales are ramped, providing a fast rolling leading edge, yet sharp effective braking and cornering edges
Progressive depth tread design offers smooth transitions between cornering lean angles
Revolutionary file-tread Gravel and Cyclocross race tire, designed for a range of conditions
Speed and traction
Aggressive file tread, or super low-profile knob design? The Terreno Dry bridges the gap between file treads, and traditional all-conditions treads. The key to this is the unique angled “fish scale” design, that allows the center tread to roll extremely fast, yet offer traction when loaded in cornering and braking. Add the transitional height mid and side tread, and the Terreno Dry transitions as smoothly as it rolls. From gravel grinding to medium conditions cross racing, the Terreno Dry offers consistent performance.
